name: save_place
title: Save Place
description: rbx-native's own tool, not one of Studio's (Studio's MCP has no way to save). Saves the place to its file, as File > Save does. Given a path, saves there instead and keeps working on that file from then on, as Save As does: .rbxl writes binary, .rbxlx XML, and a relative path is taken from the place's folder. Answers with the file written.

path.description: Save As: the .rbxl or .rbxlx file to write. Leave out to save over the place's own file.

studio_id.description: Which editor to act on: an id from list_roblox_studios. May be left out while only one editor is open.
